situation.estimate: This is a Series A company ($17M led by Spring Rock Ventures, Sep 2025; about $22M raised in total and >$10M ARR per Dealroom, unverified), with about 61 people on LinkedIn, fully remote, HQ in Seattle. It's on the Inc. 5000 and the Deloitte Fast 500 for the third year (190% three-year revenue growth). The core business is identity verification for telehealth, health systems (Epic MyChart and EpicCare Link) and financial services. On top of that it's repositioning into 'identity assurance for humans and AI agents' with Know Your Agent (Agent Checkpoint: Detect/Enforce/Govern) and KYA-OS, an open spec donated to DIF and ratified at v1.0 in Jul 2026. Marketing is in transition: the CMO it hired in Dec 2025 left by Jul 2026, and a healthcare-focused VP Marketing started Aug 2026. Meanwhile a high-volume SEO content engine runs. The homepage no longer says 'identity verification' in its title (Mar 2025: 'Digital Identity Verification'; now 'Know who's on the other end'). Heading: a two-front fight. Healthcare IDV against ID.me, CLEAR, Persona and Ping in Epic Toolbox, and the KYA category, which Persona, Entrust, Trulioo, Experian and Shufti now also claim.

outreach_angle.hook: Vouched publishes about 30 long guides a month, including its own 'best identity verification' listicles. Yet in Google's results for 'best identity verification software' and 'identity verification for telehealth' (its healthcare home turf), the vendors that show up are Persona, Jumio, Veriff, Regula and IDEMIA, not Vouched. Meanwhile Persona, Entrust, Trulioo and Experian now publish 'Know Your Agent' pages for the category Vouched says it created. seo_need.buyer_research: Buyers research online and compare vendors. Identity verification is a large, contested software category with a Gartner Magic Quadrant (Persona is a 2026 MQ Leader), a Forrester Wave, a G2 grid ('Best Identity Verification Software', updated 14 Nov 2026), Capterra, Slashdot and RFP.wiki comparisons, and dozens of vendor 'best IDV / best KYC software 2026' listicles. Vouched has a self-serve tier ('Start free', pricing pages) next to enterprise sales. The buyer set is large: telehealth, health systems, fintechs, lenders, auto dealers, gig and gaming. Health-system buying is partly channel-led (Epic Toolbox / Showroom), where ID.me, CLEAR, 1Kosmos, Ping and LexisNexis also list.

seo_need.cost_of_absence: Three concrete risks. (1) Category definition: Vouched calls itself the first KYA solution, but Entrust, Persona, Trulioo, Experian, Shufti and Baselayer now rank for 'Know Your Agent'. AI answers about KYA may name them rather than Vouched. (2) Home-turf invisibility: no page-1 presence for 'identity verification for telehealth' or 'best identity verification software', where buyers shortlist, while Persona ranks with a digital-health page and buys ads on 'Persona vs Vouched'. (3) The repositioning to 'identity assurance' dropped 'identity verification' from the homepage title, so the head term rests on blog posts. And 'Vouched vs / alternatives' is owned by aggregators (G2, RFP.wiki), which steer buyers to other vendors.
seo_need.why_not_yet: unclear: not under-investment. They invested heavily in volume (about 400 long posts since Dec 2025, an AEO-aware robots.txt, tuned internal linking), likely agency- or AI-assisted (agency_run-like; 'Vouched Editorial Team' byline, no SEO hire found). The gap is results and category presence, not effort. Marketing leadership turnover (CMO Dec 2025 - Jul 2026, new VP Aug 2026) means the program may lack an owner who measures AI visibility.
